reviewer_role: Independent read-only runner/API review; reviewer authored the separate edge-intervention extension and its synthetic checks, not this runner.
method: Static source and existing schema inspection only. No runner import/prepare/run, full graph load, simulation, fitting or new tests performed for this review.

findings: Uncaught advance exceptions could label partially mutated checkpoint coherent.
Returned output could be lost on validation/archive failure before durable publication.
Unbounded child.wait bypassed wall limits on a hung transition.
Archive-byte counter omitted temporary files, logs and other worker evidence.
Prerequisite review chains and terminal result records needed freshness checks.
The plan file itself was not bound across child dispatches.
review_corrections.resolution: Runner owner added explicit executing/confirmed-prefix state, separate returned-output retention, bounded wait and forced-stop record, actual file scans with sampling scope, prerequisite and terminal hash links, and expected-plan SHA propagation.
Failure/resource/integrity amendments were inspected. Final source-only addition requires this passed exact-source receipt and pins it plus the referenced inactive-prefix plan.

limits: These are source-review assertions, not observed execution outcomes or a second run of the synthetic checker.
Real inactive-prefix parity remains a separately frozen prerequisite; successful active execution and independent saved-data/reference checks are not certified by this receipt.
Budget measurements occur at declared samples; one operation may overshoot, and final source hashing/result publication occur after the last worker resource sample.
On a forced process stop only already durable evidence is guaranteed; a fresh full partial-state checkpoint is not guaranteed.
The active-worker file is dispatch metadata; final terminal records and process exit determine completion.
Six matched model branches do not establish biological KC specificity or physiological validity; no model gain, body, decoder or runtime default is promoted.
